title.zh: Polygon提出PIP-93：整合协议理事会等为统一安全委员会，实行8/11多签与7天时间锁
title.en: Polygon提出PIP-93：整合协议理事会等为统一安全委员会，实行8/11多签与7天时间锁

current_state.zh: Polygon published draft proposal PIP-93 to merge its Protocol Council, PoS and AggLayer multisigs into a unified 11-signer Polygon Security Council with an 8/11 signing threshold and a 7-day timelock over Ethereum and Polygon, replacing the PIP-29 governance structure.
current_state.en: Polygon published draft proposal PIP-93 to merge its Protocol Council, PoS and AggLayer multisigs into a unified 11-signer Polygon Security Council with an 8/11 signing threshold and a 7-day timelock over Ethereum and Polygon, replacing the PIP-29 governance structure.
